status: Experimental native ATen/HIP; meaningful original-model fidelity verified; complete numerical parity NOT accepted; no native API/push/PR

native_runtime.architecture: Rust -> dynamically loaded C ABI DLL -> existing native ATen/HIP; no Python interpreter, import, process or HTTP bridge
native_runtime.bootstrap: Process-local AddDllDirectory for torch/lib, _rocm_sdk_core/bin, _rocm_sdk_libraries/bin; absolute bundled amdhip64_7.dll before torch_hip.dll and shim; validate existing, transitive and late-loaded DLL paths, ABI, versions and Radeon 8060S device
native_runtime.lifetime: Opaque tensor handles use RAII; error outputs null; exceptions caught in C ABI. Failed forward clears request/cache state and rejects reuse. ATen DLL registrations retained to process exit; allocator reservations distinguished from active allocations.
native_runtime.constant_table_note: Native CPU ATen constructs only rotary constant buffers, matching the original CPU buffer initialization. All learned projections and retained matrix operations execute on HIP. No CPU model fallback.

builds.scope: 62-position run predates only final FFI integer-parameter guards and validation-runner parsing/reporting checks. Tensor equations and scheduling are unchanged. Delivery DLL has fresh 312-component and full The-logit evidence plus FFI error/lifecycle tests.
builds.runner_note: The full runner was built as aten_teacher_force_review.exe from a temporary identical source copy while aten_teacher_force.exe was still running. The copy was removed; the executable is retained. Normal reproduction builds the committed aten_teacher_force example.
builds.build_warnings: Four bundled wheel-header dllimport enum warnings; build succeeded without modifying headers.

native_summary.prompt: The capital of France is Paris. The capital of Germany is Berlin. The capital of Italy is Rome. The capital of Spain is Madrid. The capital of Portugal is Lisbon

identical_input_components.scope: Executed supported original-input probes, including complete HC, projection/dequant, RMS, pre/post, routing, Engram and attention. Unexecuted diagnostics are explicit; this is not a claim that every original 473-probe operation was newly run.

first_isolated_remaining_divergence.trace: Native and fresh unchanged HIP match through layer 19 and layer-20 FFN input; first block-output difference is layer-20 FFN.
first_isolated_remaining_divergence.replay: All 384 original router logits, softplus scores and corrected scores match exactly. The cutoff ties experts 96 and 338; native and HIP calls both select either on identical inputs.

repeat_evidence.interpretation: Observed tied selections are reported, never forced to match a saved oracle; no tolerance or deterministic tie policy introduced.

first_isolated_remaining_divergence.interpretation: This is the first isolated chat divergence, not proof that every later difference has the same cause. No deterministic tie policy, score perturbation, golden replacement, tolerance widening or selected-expert override was introduced.

deterministic_rope_correction.input: original France prefix, position 5, layer 23 attention query
deterministic_rope_correction.shape_note: A two-element complex call dispatches another ATen kernel. Regression retains the original 4096-element dispatch shape; no scalar f64 replacement.

ops_with_slabbed_head.fix: Full original FP32 [129280,5120] head shape, assembled from bounded reads on HIP

preserved_intermediate_failures.loader_attempts: Feasibility PATH-only System32 amdhip64_7.dll crashed. Production bootstrap explicitly loads bundled HIP. First native loader attempt with verbatim Windows path failed in rocBLAS path regex; canonical local-drive paths resolve it without PATH or SDK changes.

resources.cache_accounting: Packed FP4/FP8 plus scales retained on HIP. Dense converted FP32 copies counted at full converted size. HC counted separately within 256 MiB reserve. Dequant slabs, upload tensors, rotary constants, BLAS workspace and activations are allocator/workspace, not hidden resident weights.
resources.limits: Allocator figures are native process/device allocator counters, not total system GPU usage or process working set. Host KV/activation/tokenizer/catalog memory is outside weight staging. Some validation runs overlapped; timing is not a performance benchmark.

limits: Complete original-model numerical parity is not accepted. Chat differences and top-k nondeterminism remain explicit.

Maximum measured sequence length is 34. No 128-position/window-wrap equivalence, candidate pruning, arbitrary-prompt equivalence, vision, DSpark, batching, stochastic sampling or serving/API acceptance.
Rust still handles activation quantization, expert accumulation, bounded index selection, token/hash/read scheduling and host KV. This is not a fully resident ATen graph.
